title: Source-Aware Dynamic Pricing with Strategic Buyers
abstract: arXiv:2610.22516v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In modern commerce, firms and platforms typically use customer features from different sources to personalize prices: some features are verified using seller records or third-party data, while others are self-reported and may be strategically manipulated by buyers seeking lower prices. We therefore introduce a novel source-aware framework for contextual dynamic pricing with strategic buyers in a high-dimensional semiparametric setting, where buyer valuations follow a sparse linear model with an unknown noise distribution. To account for differences in manipulability across feature sources while enabling effective valuation learning, we develop the Source-Aware Localized exploration and calibrated Exploitation (SALE) pricing policy, which draws on verified features to localize price exploration and combines verified and reported features to correct for strategic manipulation during exploitation. translated_title: 面向策略性买家的来源感知动态定价
translated_abstract: 在现代商业中，企业和平台通常使用来自不同来源的客户特征来进行个性化定价：一些特征通过卖家记录或第三方数据进行验证，而另一些特征则由买家自行报告，可能被寻求更低价格的买家进行策略性操纵。因此，我们提出了一个新颖的来源感知框架，用于高维半参数设置下具有策略性买家的上下文动态定价，其中买家估值遵循具有未知噪声分布的稀疏线性模型。为了考虑不同特征来源在可操纵性上的差异，同时实现有效的估值学习，我们开发了来源感知的局部化探索与校准利用定价策略，该策略利用已验证的特征来局部化价格探索，并结合已验证特征与自行报告特征在利用阶段校正策略性操纵。我们的局部化探索设计允许……
tldr: 本文提出了SALE定价策略，利用已验证特征进行局部化价格探索并结合自报特征校正策略性操纵，从而解决高维半参数环境下存在策略性买家操纵的来源感知动态定价问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the SALE pricing policy, which leverages verified features for localized price exploration and combines self-reported features to correct strategic manipulation, addressing source-aware dynamic pricing with strategic buyers in high-dimensional semiparametric settings.
